comment: Donor spellings from the published large-donation records that are the same legal entity as a
Lobbyregister entry but cannot be matched by normalised name, because the two sources use a
different form of the company's name (an abbreviation, a dropped acronym) rather than a
different punctuation of the same words.
Every entry here is an assertion of identity that the data cannot make on its own, so each one
is hand-checked and carries the evidence for it. Add a line only after confirming the register
entry is the same legal person as the donor — a wrong line puts a false 'also a registered
lobbyist' claim next to a named company, which is worse than the undercount it fixes.
Purely typographic variants do NOT belong here. normalizeOrgName() already folds those away;
if a spelling differs only in spacing or punctuation and still fails to match, fix the
normaliser instead. build-lobby-links.mjs prints unmatched donors with prefix candidates after
every run — that list is where new entries come from.

aliases.why: Register entry 'Deutsche Vermögensberatung Aktiengesellschaft DVAG' is the same company; the donation records use the short form. Both give Frankfurt am Main as the seat. Not to be confused with R002013 'Deutscher Unternehmensverband Vermögensberatung e.V.', a trade association also seated in Frankfurt am Main — the donor is the Aktiengesellschaft, not the Verband.
Same company, name given without any legal form. Frankfurt am Main in both sources; see the note above on R002013.
